LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingMissiveGoals: Complete a task for the vivi federation to obtain an ancient amber core and build an everflower altar. Enshrine a level 4 everflower and perform the full bloom ritual to begin its fifth bloom.\n\nYou cannot request another task while an ancient amber core or altar remains.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingDesc: The everflower is condensing mana for its final bloom.\n\nDefend the altar until it is ready, then have the resonator perform the queen's coronation. If the everflower is lost, the final bloom fails.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationMissive:
The everflower resonating with {PAWN_labelShort} has reached its limit. Sensing this, the vivi federation has sent a message.

"The everflowers of the old empire bloomed on altars carved with ancient mana circuits. Once the fifth bloom begins, outlanders and titanic hornets will sense its waves too."

You can now build the everflower altar. Contact the vivi federation via comms console to obtain an ancient amber core.
LanguageData.VV_Quest_EndingMissiveStepEnshrine: Enshrine an everflower of attunement level {0} at the center of the altar
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho1:
After the ritual, a faint memory entered {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits.

A golden flower with six branches bloomed on a vast altar. The vivis beneath it knew neither unstable genes nor short lives.

"...Beneath this shade... no one withers..."

The voice faded into static.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho2:
As the ritual ended, a ringing filled {PAWN_labelShort}'s head.

In a burning hive, vivis tore at one another's wings. Neither herbs nor magic could heal their blackened wounds.

"...It's in the wind... mixed in..."
"...Before the altar... only I remain..."

{PAWN_labelShort} came to in a cold sweat.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho3:
While resonating with the everflower, {PAWN_labelShort} saw an unfamiliar memory.

Someone was opening their circuits to the limit. Dying vivis turned into small lights and gathered within a single soul.

"...If I do not die... they will not die..."
"...All of you... into me... not a single one..."

Even after the memory faded, {PAWN_labelShort} struggled to catch a breath.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho4:
As {PAWN_labelShort} finished the ritual, a broken voice came through with a surge of pain.

"...So heavy... too..."

Circuits collapsed, and a hard shell covered the body. A voice escaped between enormous mandibles.

"...Who was I... the children..."

A shadow surrounded by small lights sank into the ruins.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho5:
As mana waves spread from the everflower, static entered {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits. This time it was no memory.

Clattering shells and labored breathing. Something was approaching along the flow of mana.

"...So warm..."
"...Back... to the flower's shade..."

The connection broke.
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequest: Request an ancient amber core task
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestActive: a task has already been given
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestCoreExists: an ancient amber core or altar already exists
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestConditions: the missive's conditions are not met: {0}
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestResult: {LEADER} has offered a task with an ancient amber core as its reward.
LanguageData.VV_Comms_AmberCoreRequestNoQuest: {LEADER}: "We have no task to entrust to you right now. Contact us again later."
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiege: The everflower has entered its fifth bloom. Enemies drawn by the altar's mana waves are converging on the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederation: The vivi federation will send elite reinforcements from time to time.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationAid: The vivi federation has sent {COUNT} elite warriors to defend the everflower altar. They will fight alongside you for a time before returning home.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCalm: The raids have stopped, and the titanic hornet swarms have withdrawn. The everflower's bloom condensation has halted.\n\nThrough the resonance, {PAWN_labelShort} senses countless souls approaching, with something at their center.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingApocrypha: Dark energy gathers above the everflower. Apocrypha, the last queen of the old empire, has appeared.\n\nDriven back by the everflower's waves, she approaches the altar with a swarm of titanic hornets. Billions of fairy vivis remain bound to her.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCoronation: Apocrypha and the titanic hornets have vanished. Bloom condensation is complete, and the raids drawn by the everflower have ended.\n\n{PAWN_labelShort} can now perform the queen's coronation.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingVictoryContinue: You can continue playing in this colony with the benefits of the level 6 everflower.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCredits:
{PAWN_nameDef} completes the coronation. Golden petals form a crown above {PAWN_possessive} head.

Centuries after the old empire fell, the everflower has bloomed again. The vivis beneath it will live longer lives.

{PAWN_nameDef} has become queen of the vivis.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsNoQueen: Centuries after the old empire fell, the everflower has bloomed again. The vivis beneath it will live longer lives.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsExiled: The royal vivi once cast out for her small stature has built a hive to succeed the old empire.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsRefugee: The refugees who lost everything to the titanic hornets now have the strength to defend their hive.
LanguageData.VV_EndingCreditsOutro: The spring of the old empire begins anew here. And your story continues...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureStolen: Apocrypha has drained the everflower's power and vanished. The final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureLost: The everflower has been lost. The final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureResonator: {PAWN_labelShort} has fallen, severing the resonance with the everflower. The final bloom has failed.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingApocryphaLanded: Driven back by the everflower's wave, Apocrypha has landed at the edge of the map with a swarm of titanic hornets.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingPawnReturned: {PAWN_labelShort} has returned in front of the everflower altar.
LanguageData.VV_Message_EndingGrandAttunementNotStart: The full bloom ritual has ended, but the everflower could not begin its fifth bloom.
LanguageData.VV_Gizmo_EndingBloomDesc: The everflower is condensing mana for its final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_DialogChangeWeatherGoldenBloomDesc: Golden mist and petals cover the area, reducing ranged accuracy and granting unlimited mana to all arcane plants.
LanguageData.VV_FailReason_GoldenBloomHoldsWeather: The blooming everflower is sustaining the golden mist, preventing weather changes
